{{Quote|Many would be terrified at the very thought of traveling to Xagobah in these troubled times.|[[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba the Hutt]], to [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]]|<ref name="A New Threat">''[[Boba Fett: A New Threat]]''</ref>}}
'''Xagobah''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located in the [[Xagobah system/Legends|Xagobah system]], just inside the border with the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]], and was the [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the [[Xamster/Legends|Xamster]] race.

The Xagobah system had a blue [[Star/Legends|sun]].

==Geography==
[[File:Neva_Kee.jpg|thumb|left|180px|[[Neva Kee/Legends|Neva Kee]], a Xamster from Xagobah.]]
From space, Xagobah appeared to be a cloud-covered [[Planet/Legends|world]] that was shrouded in purplish mists. This was caused by the incredible amount of spores and pollen found in its [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]], given off by all manner of trees and [[Fungus/Legends|fungi]]. While most of the planet's spores were harmless, some varieties caused certain changes in off-worlders. As such, taking an antidote prior to exposure was recommended for those unaccustomed to the planet's environment. The fungi that produced these billions of spores resembled giant mushrooms and were found in a variety of forms. Carnivorous varieties like the [[flimmel tree]] and [[Xabar]] fungus had the ability to immobilize their prey through the use of a green, sheet-like adhesive, or through the injection of a paralyzing toxin. The [[malvil-tree]], on the other hand, was a far more docile fungus, with numerous tree-limb like tendrils that could actively move, pick up objects, and support members of the native Xamster population.

==History==
{{Quote|Lord Jabba's sources inform him that Wat Tambor is now on Xagobah. He has taken refuge in his fortress there. Republic troops have laid siege to his hideout, using a clone army led by a Jedi Master named Glynn-Beti.|[[Bib Fortuna/Legends|Bib Fortuna]], to Boba Fett|<ref name="A New Threat" />}}
Prior to Separatist occupation of Xagobah, the native Xamster race, reptilian-looking practitioners of the [[Tal-Gun]] martial arts technique, lived in relative peace. Xamster families held bonds with malvil-trees, which seemed to possess some sort of sentience, but after the war found the planet, Xamsters were either used as laborers or hired by the Republic to fight the droid armies of the [[Mazariyan]]. This left the native population devastated and the malvil-trees largely unprotected. Little is known as to what happened to them after the end of the war.

In [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], the planet was [[Battle of Xagobah (Clone Wars)|conquered]] by the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. During the [[Outer Rim Sieges/Legends|Outer Rim Sieges]], there was a CIS buildup at the world, headed by Wat Tambor of the Techno Union. Here, Tambor experimented on the native plant species and bioengineered many of them to serve his own ends.

The planet was liberated by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] in [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]], though around this same time, the [[Iron Knight]], [[Firkrann (Jedi)|Firkrann]], was killed in a duel with [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]] on the planet.

It was during the liberating battle that young [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]] attempted to collect a [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]] on [[Wat Tambor/Legends|Wat Tambor's]] head, but failed. [[Asajj Ventress/Legends|Asajj Ventress]] had supposedly helped Wat Tambor escape by damaging Boba's ship, the [[Slave I/Legends|''Slave I'']]; however, Ventress had already been betrayed by Dooku at this point, and fled into hiding to escape the war. Boba's true assailant could have been Ventress herself, but was likely another.
